name: karna-agent
description: Karna desktop agent based on NousResearch Hermes Agent, with Karna custom workflows and skills.

scripts.postinstall: echo '✅ Browser tools ready. Run: python run_agent.py --help'
scripts.test:context-os:all: python test_context_os.py && python test_context_os_e2e.py && python test_context_os_runtime.py && node --check apps/desktop/electron/karna-adapter.cjs && npm --prefix apps/desktop run test:context-os:ui && npm --prefix apps/desktop run typecheck
scripts.test:token-os:electron: node --check apps/desktop/electron/karna-adapter.cjs && node --check apps/desktop/electron/main.cjs && node apps/desktop/electron/token-os-integration.test.cjs && npm --prefix apps/desktop run typecheck
scripts.test:token-os:all: npm run test:token-os:core && npm run test:token-os:runtime && python -m compileall -q agent/context/token_os agent/context/context_orchestrator.py agent/conversation_loop.py agent/context/api/context_memory_api.py && npm run test:token-os:electron
